verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's only documented programmatic interface is its own HTTP MCP server, which agent clients such as Claude Code and Codex can use to read and edit the Model and drive Ari chats outside the web UI. That gives some non-UI, automatable access. But the docs state no API keys or access tokens are issued and every client signs in as a person, which works against unattended CI runs. No CLI or OpenAPI spec exists (all probed OpenAPI paths return 404). Missing for 10: non-interactive/service-account auth for CI, an official CLI or REST API, documented headless/CI usage examples, independent corroboration.
